title: Section 450.14 – Revise Section 450.14 to read as follows:
officialText:
450.14 Disconnecting Means
(A) Location. Transformers, other than Class 2 or Class 3 transformers, shall have a disconnecting means located
either in sight of the transformer or in a remote location. Where located in a remote location, the disconnecting means
shall be lockable open in accordance with 110.25, and its location shall be field marked on the transformer.
(B) Rating. For all step-up transformer applications over 225kVA, the selection of the Primary Disconnect and Step-
Up Transformer shall be considered as an engineered system and shall be installed in accordance with 110.3(B) and
in compliance with 110.9 and 110.10. The Primary Disconnect device shall be capable of handling the maximum
inrush current of the specific transformer being installed. The selection shall be made by a registered design
professional engaged primarily in the design, installation, or maintenance of electrical systems. The selection shall be
documented and made available to those authorized to design, install, inspect, maintain, and operate the system.
